name: cloudflare-code-reviewer
description: Advanced Track: full 7-pillar security suite, SQLite Durable Objects, and multi-model committee. An automated GitHub PR code review agent running on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, and Alibaba OCR rules. The Starter Track lives in its own isolated ./starter directory (see starter/package.json) so Cloudflare's Deploy to Workers button can target each track independently.
